title: Harlie's House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the desirable Grande Pointe at Inlet Beach, this exquisite four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom beach house is the ultimate vacation retreat. Offering a perfect blend of luxury and comfort, the home is pet-friendly and includes a golf cart and bikes for your convenience. The spacious living area features a large smart TV, perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and adjacent dining area caters to all your culinary needs. Each bedroom is designed for relaxation, with three king-sized beds, smart TVs, and two en suite bathrooms. The fourth bedroom is ideal for kids with a full bunk bed and its smart TV. Grande Pointe's prime location, just east of Rosemary Beach, offers access to pristine beaches, shopping, and dining. The community pool overlooks Lake Powell, the largest coastal dune lake in Florida, providing stunning views and a serene setting. Enjoy the private community dock, pavilion, and a range of outdoor activities including fishing, hiking, and kayaking at nearby Camp Helen State Park. With high-speed Wi-Fi, a laundry room, and a cozy outdoor seating area, this vacation home ensures every detail is curated for an unforgettable stay.
